title: resolver task subdivide (resolver-subdivide/2)
description: Structured output of the resolver's subdivide task (docs/outliner-design.md §5.6): inferred divisions for a leaf whose span is long, or for every leaf in a model-only run, up to three levels deep, and the lines of the leaf's span that belong to none of them. One division per parent; omit a leaf you cannot judge. Merge rules (outline/resolver.py): parent_id must be a listed leaf; children in outline order, depth 1 = a child of the leaf, depth d + 1 = a child of the nearest depth-d division before it; every divided node has at least two children, in text order inside its span, not overlapping (a shared boundary line is allowed); each child confidence < 1 and a non-empty rationale; children become origin 'inferred' nodes with evidence = rationale. Uncovered ranges lie inside the leaf's span between the depth-1 divisions; 'overrun' ranges are reported (resolver report 'overruns') and change no span. A window of a too-long leaf takes depth-1 divisions that begin in its core only; the windows are joined into one division. Version 2 (2026-10-01) adds depth and uncovered. Constraint keywords (minimum, maximum) are enforced client-side; llm.api_schema strips them for the API.

parent_id.description: An id listed under 'Leaves to subdivide'.

children.description: The divisions in outline order (each followed by its own sub-divisions); [] when the leaf reads as one unit.

heading_src.description: Short classical Chinese heading in kepan style (e.g. 初明…, 次…, 後…).

start.description: First line of the division's span, a linehead exactly as shown in the request (no ':offset'): root text in sutra mode, the outlined text in self-outlining mode.

end.description: Last line of the division's span (inclusive), a linehead from the same text as start. In a window: the last line shown when the division runs on past it.

depth.description: 1 = a child of the leaf; 2 = a child of the nearest depth-1 division before it; 3 = a child of the nearest depth-2 division before it. A window takes depth 1 only.

explained.description: Sutra mode: the commentary linehead where the commentary takes this division up, or null. Self-outlining mode: the line inside the division's span where the text's own treatment of it begins, when that is not its first line; null = its start.

confidence.description: Calibrated probability that this division is right; the pipeline accepts only values below 1.

rationale.description: The textual cue relied on, quoting the Chinese; stored as the node's evidence. Must not be empty.

uncovered.description: Lines of the leaf's span left out of every division (gaps between depth-1 divisions, or before the first or after the last); [] when the divisions cover the span.

start.description: First uncovered line, a linehead from the same text as the divisions.

kind.description: paratext: a title, a 卷 heading or colophon, a translator or editor line, a blank or note line. overrun: text that belongs to a division the outline does not list (the leaf's span runs past its own text, e.g. a later sibling the parser missed).

rationale.description: Why these lines belong to no division, quoting the Chinese. Must not be empty.
